title: WPMS/2148/2021 of SHIKSHA VIKAS SAMITI NAYAGAON MALHAN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
MCC NO. 3 of 2022
in
WPMS No. 2148 of 2021
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
 None is present for petitioner.
Mr. T.S.Phartiyal, learned Deputy
Advocate General for the State.
Mr. Sadeep Kothari, learned counsel
for the intervener.
Writ petition was dismissed vide
order dated 06.01.2022. Today, matter is
listed on Modification Application.
Modification has been sought on the
ground that it is only respondent no.1,
who can look into the question of validity
of appointment of Authorized Controller.
 There is no representation for the
applicant.
 Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned
counsel for Intervener points out that the
dispute involved in the writ petition is not
regarding appointment of Authorized
Controller. The question involved in the
matter is regarding election of Committee of
Management. Learned counsel for the
Intervener also submits that Regional
Additional Director, Pauri Garhwal, is
competent to go into the question of validity
of election of Committee of Management.
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, also points out
that pursuant to order of this Court,
Regional Additional Director, Pauri
Garhwal, has taken a decision on the
representation of petitioner.
In view of the above, this Court does
not find any reason to entertain the
Modification Application.

Accordingly, the Modification
Application is rejected.
